result:
I fixed the double counting in `weeklyRevenue` (`src/revenue.mjs`). Order 7 now counts once at 5000 cents. Both tests pass.

The function used to add the order's full amount once per payment record, so two instalments counted the order twice. It now collects the set of paid order IDs and goes through the orders once. Each paid order is added once, at its full amount, to the UTC week of its creation. The signature and return shape are unchanged.

I added a regression test in `test/revenue.test.mjs` for an order with two payments. I haven't committed anything.
